heading.title: Provisions as to Bail and Bonds

article.title: Bond required from child
article.content: When the person required by any Court, or officer to execute a bond is a child, such Court or officer may accept, in lieu thereof, a bond executed by a surety or sureties only.
article.html:
494Bond required from child

Section 494 · Chapter XXXV

When the person required by any Court, or officer to execute a bond is a child, such Court or officer may accept, in lieu thereof, a bond executed by a surety or sureties only.
